h: Tinubu's 2027 re-election campaign flags off in Kaduna today
p: The APC is launching President Tinubu's second-term campaign in Kaduna on Saturday, the first stop on a tour of selected states. Port Harcourt is reportedly next on 7 November, with a closing rally planned for Lagos in January. Rival camps, including Atiku's ADC and the Obi-Kwankwaso NDC, have also been mobilising their own campaign councils.
more: Campaign DG Abdulaziz Yari says Tinubu has a broader national base than his challengers.
The presidential election is reportedly set for 16 January 2027.
Supporters of other APC figures have also been reacting to the flag-off.
